qa_pairs.question: What special tool is used to bolt down and press off the bevel gear?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 33 1 150 with M 8 x 30 bolts and nuts is used to bolt down and press off the bevel gear.

qa_pairs.question: What components need to be removed after taking off the bushing and spacer?
qa_pairs.answer: After taking off bushing (1) and spacer (2), the tapered roller bearing needs to be pulled off using Special Tools 31 5 090 and 33 1 301.

qa_pairs.question: Which special tools are required to pull off the tapered roller bearing?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tools 31 5 090 and 33 1 301 are required to pull off the tapered roller bearing.

qa_pairs.question: Which special tools are used to press both bearing outer races out of the case?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tools 33 1 370, 33 4 041 and 33 4 042/044 are used to press both bearing outer races out of the case.

qa_pairs.question: What special tools are required to press in new bearing outer races?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tools 31 5 100, 33 1 374 and 33 4 041/042/044 are required to press in new bearing outer races.

qa_pairs.question: What is the final step when installing the bevel gear into the case?
qa_pairs.answer: The final step is to slide the bevel gear into case (1) and drive in the new bearing with Special Tool 23 1 160 far enough that rollers have light contact on bearing outer race.

qa_pairs.question: What part numbers are associated with the bearing pressing tools shown in the middle right diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The part numbers shown are 33 4 042, 33 4 041, 33 4 044, and 33 1 370 for the bearing pressing tool assembly.

qa_pairs.question: What is the key requirement when driving in the new bearing with Special Tool 23 1 160?
qa_pairs.answer: The new bearing must be driven in far enough that the rollers have light contact on the bearing outer race.

qa_pairs.question: What components are visible in the lower left diagram with part number 33 1 301?
qa_pairs.answer: The lower left diagram shows the tapered roller bearing being pulled off using Special Tool 31 5 090 and puller 33 1 301.

qa_pairs.question: What is installed along with the new bushing according to the upper right instruction?
qa_pairs.answer: A spacer (2) is installed along with the new bushing (1).
